an5.64:1.1: “Bhikkhus, growing in five ways, a female noble disciple grows by a noble growth, and she absorbs the essence and the best of this life.
an5.64:1.3: She grows in faith, virtuous behavior, learning, generosity, and wisdom.
an5.64:1.4: Growing in these five ways, a female noble disciple grows by a noble growth, and she absorbs the essence and the best of this life.”
an5.64:2.1: She who grows in faith and virtuous behavior,
an5.64:2.3: such a virtuous female lay follower
an5.64:2.4: absorbs for herself the essence of this life.
